class.name: NNBTDelayer
class.brief_description: Waits for [member wait_time] seconds before running its child branch.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while accumulating tick [code]delta[/code] until [member wait_time] seconds have elapsed, then ticks its child and passes through its result. Use this to add pauses, reaction delays, or wind-ups before an action in a sequence. The delay resets on each new run or interrupt.

method.name: get_time_waited
method.description: Returns the seconds accumulated toward [member wait_time] in the current run.

members.member: Delay in seconds before ticking the child. Set to [code]0.0[/code] or less to tick the child immediately.
